title: Unsourced Fact Hotspot Finder
dataSources: Tree records (`genealogy:record`), DNA matches (`dna:match`), ancestor events (`ancestor:event`), archive documents (`archive:document`), tree nodes (`familytree:node`).
app: Genealogy and family-history research — tree platforms (Ancestry, FamilySearch), DNA match exports (23andMe, MyHeritage), and document / archive catalogues — streamed to Splunk HEC via GEDCOM and CSV exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=familytree:node
| stats sum(fact_count) as facts, sum(sourced_fact_count) as sourced_facts by branch
| eval unsourced_facts=facts-sourced_facts
| sort - unsourced_facts
description: Shows which family branches have the largest backlog of unsourced claims or copied facts.
value: Unsourced facts create fragile trees; hotspot analysis directs effort to the least trustworthy areas first.
implementation: Capture total and sourced fact counts in `familytree:node` and rank branches by unsourced backlog.
visualization: Bar chart of unsourced facts by branch.
grandmaExplanation: It watches which parts of the family tree have the most facts that still need real proof behind them.
